bukti: a lightweight YOLO v5s-MCA model for tomato ripeness detection was proposed. The model categorized tomato ripeness into four distinct stages: mature, turning mature, color transition, and immature.
The model achieved a precision of 92.8% and a mean average precision (mAP) of 95.1%

bukti: This research focuses on the performance of the detection method of YOLOv4 in detecting and collecting FFB on the ground via a RealSense camera.
The recognition performance is improved significantly from YOLOv4 to YOLOv4-tiny in term of the FPS and the time taken for the detection.

c1.hasil_ringkas: Citrus-YOLO dengan DeepSort dan penghitung terdistribusi tidak seragam pada video UAV mencapai F1 89,07% dan MAPE pencacahan 12,75%.

bukti: the DeepSort algorithm was used to assign a specific ID to each citrus fruit in the online UAV scene and track the fruits across video frames.
a nonuniform distributed counter was proposed to correct the fruit count during the tracking process
the F1 score and mean absolute percentage error of the method are 89.07% and 12.75%, respectively
catatan: DeepSORT dikodekan M2+M3 sesuai konvensi. Abstrak tidak menyebut acuan hitung; anotasi video diasumsikan. Penghitung koreksi bekerja di dalam proses pelacakan, bukan regresi terhadap hitungan acuan.

c1.hasil_ringkas: Faster R-CNN ResNet-101 mencapai AP 87,83% (IoU >= 0,5) dan R2 pencacahan 0,87 pada subcitra; 1.422 tomat dideteksi dan dipetakan pada citra jahitan satu baris rumah kaca.

bukti: The detection on test dataset achieved high average precision of 87.83% (intersection over union ≥ 0.5) and showed a high accuracy of tomato counting (R2 = 0.87).
all the detected boxes were merged into one image to compile the tomato location map and estimate their size along one row in the greenhouse.

catatan: Evaluasi pencacahan (R2 0,87) dilakukan per subcitra, sehingga kode utama C2. C1 dicatat sebagai kode tambahan karena foto bertumpang tindih dijahit menjadi mosaik sebelum deteksi; registrasi mosaik 2D itu yang mencegah hitung ganda dan dikodekan M4 secara longgar (bukan 3D). Tidak ada hitungan per kelas.
